result.title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
result.comment: Author-revised preprint; journal version published in AI Plus; 20 pages, 3 figures, and 3 tables; position paper and narrative survey
result.summary: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_θ(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_θ$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. Pretraining scaling invests in $θ$; decision-time scaling searches, refines, or verifies decisions under supplied context; context scaling improves the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state for model use. The three programs interact, but only $B_c$ targets what the system can make available before a decision. This view makes the model-infrastructure pair the unit of analysis. We define effective-context value as a task- and intervention-dependent attribution, separate deployment state from model-visible context, and identify availability, fidelity, selection, and utilization failures. We then organize current mechanisms through a five-operation context lifecycle and propose controlled budget interventions and utility-cost curves for evaluation. The resulting agenda centers on grounded reporting, interaction-data and full-cost infrastructure, and safety and governance for persistent, adaptive systems.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一篇 position paper，提出「context scaling」框架：把模型视为 P_θ(d|c)，用训练、决策时与上下文基础设施三类预算刻画系统，将部署状态与模型可见上下文分离，把失效归为可用性、保真度、选择与利用四类，并以五项操作的上下文生命周期组织现有机制与评估方式。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态可得性与模型可见上下文分离」及选择/利用失效的分类，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、视觉旁路导致的可用信息损失及评价设计形成概念呼应，可供核查；但论文不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成。
